serviceName: Verificação de domínio para uma conta da Lighthouse North
description: Publishes the TXT record that proves ownership of a sending domain on Lighthouse North, an omnichannel messaging platform (Brazil). Applied before the DKIM template (lighthousenorth.com.br.email-dkim).
variableDescription: lnverify: random ownership token generated by Lighthouse North for this domain (base64url, 32 chars)
